The '''Battle of Crombach Nebula''' was a battle during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] that was fought at the [[Crombach Nebula]] sometime prior to the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]<ref name="ICS" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> During the engagement&mdash;which involved forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] facing forces of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]&mdash;the Confederate [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] ''[[Tide of Progress XII/Legends|Tide of Progress XII]]'' was lightly damaged when the Republic-allied [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Wom-Nii Gnaden/Legends|Wom-Nii Gnaden]]<ref name="ICS" /> lost control<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|I|348|Gnaden, Wom-Nii}}</ref> and crashed his [[NTB-630 naval bomber]] into it.<ref name="ICS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Crombach Nebula was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]'', a [[2005]] [[Book/Legends|reference book]] authored by [[Curtis Saxton]].<ref name="ICS" />
